adaptation: CommonJS modules converted to ESM with named exports.
readability() and the WCAG threshold constants were added so the contrast verdict lives in one place instead of being recomputed by each caller.
ramp() was added: the deterministic lightness ramp used by the incubator room now has a single home instead of living in the room handler.
buildSwatch() was added on top of the donor canvas helpers so a palette becomes an image deterministically.

The donor's permanent product nouns were not carried into Utopia's public API: hns_native -> owned_surface, official_shell -> external_shell, official_overlay -> owned_overlay, official_renderer -> protected_external_surface, the hns./official.* slot families -> surface./shell./overlay./external.*, and the CSS custom properties --hns-* -> --utopia-*. Every safety semantic (slot permissions, protected-surface refusal, declarative-only packages, asset confinement, contrast and state separability, overlay ceilings) is preserved.
The validator gained validateDocuments(): the same checks now run over in-memory documents as over a materialized package directory, so the incubator room can validate without writing a file.
The overlay strength ceilings moved into the validator, so a package's declared overlay plan is checked against the engineering limits rather than only the builder's own downgrade ladder.
knownDifferences: No theme application: this module produces and validates packages; nothing is applied to any UI.
No registry, lifecycle or recovery: the donor's orchestration layer is out of scope.
No builder or designer: the D6b donor closure (builder.js, designer.js and the assets/ planner, generator, processor, validator and fallback modules) is not carried in this wave.
No image model: procedural generation is deterministic and offline, and an injected image generator is not part of this wave.
